description:
Radio Automation is a purpose built audio player for an off hour animated light show.

Radio Automation is a purpose built audio player designed to be a off hours music player for my animated light display during the holidays.
Features
- Audio: Retry dropped internet streams with exponential backoff (02f5310)
Bug Fixes
- audio: Enumerate source sequences once (b3d957b)
- audio: Set Device.IsDefault from constructor and promote rule to error (a87a4d1)
- AudioTrackParser: Match audio file extensions case-insensitively (fd58ae0)
- AudioTrackParser: Return each track once from recursive scans (66621c5)
- AudioTrackParser: Skip unreadable audio files in folder scans (145c978)
- Extensions: Support nullable enums in EnumerationExtension (c9a88b6)
- FileExtensions: Detect encoding for short files and UTF-32 (4bde539)
- globalization: Format temperature file names invariantly (158c6e7)
- globalization: Parse PercentageConverter operands invariantly (49faddf)
- lifetime: Make Clock disposable and dispose it on close (f688394)
- logging: Replace console error with a real log entry (4cf050f)
- nullable: Drop unscoped nullable annotations in MainWindowViewModel (e0ec5a3)
- Track: Assign Id in the stream track constructor (bca3841)
- Track: Handle empty lists in tag and genre formatting (a495e7b)
Performance
- analyzers: Hoist constant arrays and cache JsonSerializerOptions (da9b197)
Continuous Integration
- build: Run unit tests before versioning (d2483d8)
- workflows: Build the app project instead of the installer on PRs (25a95dc)
- workflows: Validate build and tests on pull requests (63ef332)
Documentation
- CLAUDE: Document test project and conventions (c4ea68b)
- CLAUDE: Update known defect testing guidance (dac7220)
- readme: Point to wiki for full documentation (d141780)
